maddeler.e:
افتليا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَلَيَا (iftalayā) /if.ta.la.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
# اُفْتُلِيَا (uftuliyā) /uf.tu.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
# اِفْتَلِيَا (iftaliyā) /if.ta.li.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
